description: The instinct page reports Laukkonen and colleagues (2022): an aha moment from solving an anagram made an unrelated belief presented at the same time seem truer.
limitations: Task-based insights, which the page notes are not the rare, intense experiences its hypothesis is about. The study was not opened for this record.
